sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, o.created_at::text AS t, coalesce(o.strategy,'-') AS b, o.market_ticker AS c, coalesce(o.side,'-') AS d, o.limit_price::text AS e, o.quantity::text AS f, coalesce(o.status,'-') AS h FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 5) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, p.captured_at::text, 'pos', p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.side,'-'), p.quantity::text, coalesce(p.avg_price::text,'-'), coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-') FROM positions p WHERE p.captured_at > now() - interval '12 minutes' AND (p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' OR p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXRT-RES%') ORDER BY p.captured_at DESC LIMIT 6) UNION ALL (SELECT 3 AS g, ev.at::text, 'evt', ev.kind, '-', '-', '-', left(coalesce(ev.detail_json::text, coalesce(ev.detail,'-')),260) FROM incentive_collector_events ev WHERE ev.kind = 'discovery' ORDER BY ev.at DESC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (SELECT 4 AS g, max(ip.last_seen_at)::text, 'paidout', coalesce(ip.status_observed,'-'), count(*)::text, '-', '-', '-' FROM incentive_programs ip WHERE ip.status_observed IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ip.status_observed)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
